subject: Budget range validation - NovaPay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Langford <chris@novapay.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@novapay.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@novapay.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Budget range validation - NovaPay

Thanks again for taking the time today, Chris — great conversation. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can get a scoped pilot/quote over to you.

Recap from today
- Primary use case: transaction enrichment + customer support assistant (low hallucination tolerance).
- Expected volume (initial -> steady state): 20M - 60M tokens / month (seasonal peaks). You mentioned mid-point ~35M as a working average.
- Budget band you called out: roughly $10k - $30k / month.
- Procurement thresholds you described: internal procurement needs a PO + SOW above ~$25k per month; smaller pilots can be done via a single vendor approval / credit-card up to ~$10k. CFO requires formal review for annual > $100k.

Unit economics / target
- You said a target unit economics target of approximately $/1M tokens to hit your budgets. Using the numbers above, that implies a target price in the ~$500 / 1M tokens range (20M * $500 = $10k; 60M * $500 = $30k). Please confirm whether $/1M = ~$500 is the right ballpark or if your team is targeting a different figure.

What I attached
- Redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf (list + committed discounts by capacity and term) [attachment stub]
- Mutual-Action-Plan-NovaPay.xlsx (proposed milestones, procurement milestones, pilot success metrics) [attachment stub]

Open questions / asks
1) Can you confirm the expected steady-state monthly token volume (low / mid / high) for procurement: you listed 20M / 35M / 60M. Which band should we price around?
2) Confirm the procurement trigger: is $25k/month the formal PO threshold or is there flexibility for a 3-month PO for pilots?
3) Any compliance gating (SOC2, data residency) we should attach to the proposal now?

Next steps
- If the $/1M ~ $500 target is accurate, I’ll draft a 3-month pilot quote and sample SOW that targets 50M tokens / month at a committed pilot price (and show both hosted + dedicated capacity pricing).
- I can schedule a short procurement call next week with Samantha / Alex to align on PO timing.

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Budget range validation - NovaPay

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with procurement: 

- Volume: the 20M / 35M / 60M bands are correct. For procurement we should price against the mid-band (35M) but show both low/high sensitivity.
- Procurement thresholds: internal policy is a bit fuzzy: we can do a 3-month PO for pilots, but anything that would create an annualized commitment > $100k needs the procurement committee sign-off. For pilots we typically do a 3-month PO in the $30k - $75k range.
- Target $/1M: our finance lead would like to see committed pricing that lands us around $400 - $500 per 1M tokens for the committed pilot; $500 is acceptable if you can show upside on dedicated capacity.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II is required; data residency in us-east is preferred but not strictly required for the pilot.

Question: does Redwood offer a lower effective $/1M on Dedicated capacity or for committed monthly spend? If so, what rough % should we use when modeling?

Thanks — looping in Samantha and Alex to keep procurement context.
— Chris
VP Product, NovaPay

Appreciate the quick turn, Chris — that's exactly the detail we needed. Short answers inline: 

- Pricing on Dedicated / committed spend: yes — we typically provide an incremental discount for dedicated capacity (lower unit price) plus additional operational SLAs. For modeling you can use ~20% off hosted list as a conservative estimate; committed multi-month pilots (3-12 months) can push effective $/1M lower depending on the term and committed token volume. Example: at mid-band 35M/month, a 3-month committed pilot at target discount levels would put you in the ~$400 / 1M tokens ballpark (rough estimate). We'll show exact numbers in the formal quote.
- Procurement: 3-month PO for pilot is workable; we'll model a 3-month pilot and a month-to-month renewal option.
- Compliance: we can share SOC 2 Type II report and sample SOW in the next email/package.

I'll send a draft quote + sample SOW early Monday and propose a 30-min procurement sync for Tue/Wed next week. If you'd like faster cadence I can circle back with a high-level committed quote today.

Next immediate step on my side
- Draft 3-month pilot quote (50M tokens/month target) with both hosted and dedicated pricing lines.
- Include SOC2 evidence and sample SOW.

Would you prefer the 50M pilot target or should I price to your mid-band 35M/month? If you want procurement to sign, 50M makes the pilot more comprehensive; 35M is a more conservative starting point.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Dylan — forwarding the thread. Quick internal ask: can you draft a 3-month pilot pricing proposal + sample SOW based on the following assumptions?
- Pilot target: 50M tokens / month (we'll also show a mid-band 35M sensitivity).
- Target effective price: aim to show committed pricing that gets NovaPay to ~$400 / 1M on dedicated (include hosted list and dedicated discounted line).
- Include options: hosted (no commit), committed hosted (3-month PO), dedicated reserved pool (3-month minimum) with 20% off hosted list and an alternate 30% discount line if they commit to 6 months.
- Include SOC2 Type II evidence link and a short compliance appendix.
- Confirm capacity availability in us-east and any lead time for dedicated pool provisioning.

Can you get a draft into my inbox Monday morning? If you need me to jump on a quick call with procurement I can.

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
